$comment: T-3.35 mission thresholds, asserted by `pnpm sim-run --scenario mission` (and its three-seed CI job). Six friendly bots play greybox-01 against its committed encounter, paced by the director, at each of `budgets` (the director's human count, overridden for this tool alone), for up to `runSeconds` a seed. A scripted squad leader walks fireteam 1 up the overwatch route and fireteam 2 up the assault route stop by stop (a stop is reached once every member on its feet is within `arriveM`, or `stopSeconds` have passed), then — once the approach is walked — has every bot attack the nearest living enemy within `clearWithinM` of the objective's area and holds it with both only when none is left (B-11, 2026-09-26: walking the squad into the middle of the garrison lost every run), and sends the nearest bot on its feet to revive whoever goes down; the bots fight, take cover and follow the orders on their own. Asserted per budget, on a run of at least `completionMinSeeds` seeds: completion share at least `minCompletion[budget]` (the three-seed CI job reports completion and does not assert it: three runs cannot measure a rate). The completion floors sit just under the baseline measured when this landed (2026-09-23: 30% at one human, 15% at six, over 20 seeds): they catch the squad getting worse, not a target met — bots lose most firefights today (docs/BUGS.md). Over all runs: enemies under fire (suppression at or above `underFireLevel`, or hurt in the last `hurtSeconds`) spend at least `minCoverShare` of that time in a cover point they hold; and at least `minEpisodesPerEngagement` suppression episodes (a squad soldier's suppression rising through `episodeLevel`) per engagement (a stretch of enemy contact). AI cost: `bench.enemies` riflemen and `bench.bots` friendly bots with one human, `bench.seconds` of it; the AI's share of the 33.3 ms tick must stay under `maxAiShare`. 2026-09-26 (B-11): with the leader clearing before it holds, 20 seeds complete 45% at one human and 25% at six (from 0% and 0% with the old walk-in, after B-15); the floors stay where T-3.35 set them. With T-5.06's bots taking cover under fire on attack, move and hold orders: 60% at one human and 20% at six; with the old walk-in leader, still 5% and 0%. 2026-09-26 (T-5.02): the scenario now plays the slice mission — five objectives, about ten minutes — so `runSeconds` is 720, the leader walks the routes into whichever objective clears and holds the compound (joining each route at its nearest stop), and the report gives the median completed length beside the mean. 20 seeds: 70% at one human (median 511 s), 75% at six (median 570 s); enemies under fire in cover 28%. U-001 (2026-09-26): on every run, CI's included, the squad may not go longer than `maxQuietSeconds` without an enemy in contact (one knowing of a squad soldier) while a timed objective runs — contact, not presence: an enemy standing out of sight in its spawn zone is no pressure. Before U-001 the defend stood empty its whole 330 s (355–391 s with the hold before it) in every six-human run. The ceiling allows the compound's intentional quiet hold (60 s once the first counterattack is beaten) and the defend's first wave reaching the squad. With the defend's own counterattack (sent when it starts, stopped when it is won) the defend is a fight, and a squad that comes into it hurt loses it (B-11): 20 seeds complete 50% at one human (median 517 s) and 60% at six (median 494 s); enemies under fire in cover 25%, at its floor — the defend's attackers cross open ground; longest quiet 84 s. U-011 (2026-09-27): mission-01's hold and defend are now the garrison's destruction and an upload at the compound's terminal that the counterattack tries to cut at its lever; the leader walks the approach into the garrison objective, holds a bot at the terminal (it restarts the upload after each cut) and the rest between terminal and lever, and a running upload counts as a timed objective for `maxQuietSeconds`. 20 seeds: 95% at one human (median 353 s), 90% at six (median 366 s); enemies under fire in cover 37% (the lever's user takes cover near itself and breaks off while under fire); suppression episodes 4.08 per engagement. The floors stay. U-084 (2026-10-01): since the mission fails on the first death or all six down (dadd365, 2026-09-29) the same squad completes far less often than the 95%/90% above — 90%/50% just before that rule, 40%/10% with it, and 10%/0% over 20 seeds by 2026-10-01 once the tank (U-069) came. Two causes of casualties before the upload were the scripted lead's and the bots': the lead sent the assault fireteam up its route while the overwatch team was still 40 m back (the faster reached the garrison alone, 6-14 s ahead), so now one team does not start its last leg while another has not started its own, for up to `groupUpSeconds`; and a hurt bot never used its three health kits while it waited on a hold or finished move, so friendly.json now has it use one on itself when calm. 20 seeds: 50% at one human (was 10%), 0% at six (was 0%: its early fights, with the east-lane wave on the squad as it sprints between stops, are U-085). U-085 (2026-10-01, owner's decision): the floors are re-baselined from 20 seeds and CI now asserts this scenario at 20 seeds (it asserted at 3, which cannot measure a rate). Measured: 50% at one human, 0% at six. Floors: 25% at one human (about a quarter of what the squad does, because one AI change moved 10-seed completion by three seeds either way and a gate on that noise would fail good work) and 0% at six (it asserts nothing, deliberately, until U-087's squad tactics exist: 0 of 20 is the honest number). U-095 (2026-10-02): The Qalat Road baseline, real six-bot orders and unmodified health/damage, 20 seeds per budget: 0/20 (0%) at one human and 0/20 (0%) at six. At each budget 13 runs fail in Approach and 7 reach the rescue stage; 18 first-soldier deaths and 2 all-downed failures. No run frees the POW or reaches armour/extraction. Authored fixed opposition counts make these runs identical at the two budgets. No Qalat completion floor is guessed; the existing slice floors and pressure/AI gates remain. CI runs Qalat explicitly over 20 seeds diagnostically, with malformed data/runner errors/stalls failing. Owner playtest of length, lanes, difficulty and feel remains owed.
